Supermarket In Burleson Texas Tells All Their Customers Everything In Their Baskets Are Free Because Computer Issue Crashed All The Cash Registers
25 mins ago
Audio By Carbonatix
The H-E-B store in Burleson, Texas, gave away full baskets of groceries to shoppers on Monday after a computer issue crashed all the cash registers.
Instead of turning customers away, the store decided to "gift" the items to those already in line in celebration of the Christmas season.
Shoppers who arrived after the system failed were turned away at the door. Still, they said they were happy for those who had fortunate timing.
